book.name: Márkosarini
book.title: Márkosarini kuku Nuw Márkosi yuwaa Isus tayaspatarangu anoo kamanchintspa

content: Na ichtaru, yuwaa Isus nish taarangu, iyaam yutaritshishirineemani tsiparangu anoo kamanchintspa.
Sirútamasa zitaminarini Isáysarini yuwaa Apanll tárangu anoo yandarangiya. Anush Apanll, tárangiya:
uwsha táchparee, tárangiya Apanlliya.

Ashiriya, yuwaa, tárangu anoo na tatsameenllcha. Wangarini ichumampanirini ipusap kusarangu amb tputsee chamayangayaru, tayaspatarangiya zapan tsupi. Yutaritshishireetsis kasakchus, kuzizimun kuskachu an mangeetsis tachingchintsa izuurashtaya, tayaspataku, tárangiya.
Utaáshuchinand yakat kus kus ashirangana. Irusarinshuch tputs kusarangtamsin, ichingurusin yutaritshishirineetsi kamanirangtamsin, Wangarinsha ichumarangiya Ortagush kungu.
Itaru, Wangarinshacha wamar kameechpat puru k'tama anpat kamartarangiya. Wichpooshshacha tasi kichpurangiya. Mishacha watungash pchichpaz ashiru kindurpatpaz ashiru íseeru katungarangiya.

Tayaspataku; tputsee mang' yaramaam zandku, Nuwsha kungupa ichumakina. Itaru, nllitaritsha tputs kuzizimun kuschiya. Kizpur nuwaa kasiriya; nuw anpa waritareezi. Itaru, uwsha Apanllee Wani tputsush tapshtukachu, Apanlleetsimari minamari mangooz chinachinllinaya. Ashku an kuskachu, nuwaa: Sapturee tpurinda tákchu, nuwataa pinasakina, watam kizpur kurakawa; tárangiya Wangarini. Ashiri yuwaa Wangarini tayaspatarangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, minush zari Wangarini Isusoo ichumarangu anoo kamanchintspa
Yuwashtam Wangarini tputsee ichumaku taaru anush ashishtaru anshutam, Isus Násaretush, Galileyash tsap káyaranllu, Ortagush kusarangiya. Anushcha Wangarin Isusootssha Ortagush kung ichumarangitamta.
Ichumaramchu, kungush kárirangu, kanindsha tawata ashirangu, Apanllsha Wani makook tamapari ashiru, karuwataranllu, Isusumun waziyarangiya; pshturangiya.
Kanindapsha íwarta k'kuz kizpur kimarangu; Nuw shiyaa ipartana; tárangiya. Shiyamun mangi kischa.
Shiyaa kizpur chinakina, mang tárangiya.
Chumaramchu, Apanll Wani Isusoo machtarangiya yap kázamish taaru ambi.
Amb machip 40 maats taarangiya. Anush Yashing' kizpur kiyung yachayaru kasarangiya. Apanll wasundurur ksutarangiya. Ashiri yuwaa Wangarini Isusoo ichumarangu anoo kamaneena.
Mishat, yuwaa Isus tayaspatamaam chtarangu anoo kamanchintspa
Yuwapur Herodesarin Wangarineetsi tumanaramchu anpurtam Isussha musap Galileyap kanapeeranllu, anush Apanllee kuk tayaspatarangiya.
Na waritayanllcha, tárangiya. Musásiriparee Apanll waana kuschiya wamari kasimaama. Yutaritshishireetsis kasayarus, Apanllee kuk mangoonangtsa; tárangiya. Isus ántaru tayaspatamaam chtarangiya.
Tayaspatataru anushsha xiytu, Isus Galileyamun mus wing' Simoo chamayangarangiya. Sim zoonllpa Ándarispa kayupcheem kawaksin parangiya; watam kayupchipanimunawa.
Isussha, Nuwash tchitangandama, tárangiya. Siy kayupchipanimunta taarangus, natsha tputsireetsi tayaspatatssa Apanllee mangoonamaama, tárangiya.
Isus tárangu, musásiritam ireetaa kasayarusin, Isusshuri tachitaranganaya.
Isus naantachu, Sípitiyurineetsi wip, Sandeekurinee yusur chamayangarangiya. Zoonllpat Wangpata parangitamta. Kanush kuxineersin, ireetarineetsi yarayartat ashirangana.
Isussha: Naani; táyaru, waparee botish istampanpat kasayaranllu, Isusush tachitaranganaya.
Minush zari Isus yaktash Kapárnáwash mang kusarangiya. Sápatush zari Utaáshuchish shaniyshini pshtuyaru, tayaspatarangiya.
Isus tayaspataku, putitiri tsiyatarangiya; ichinguru tputs, punirustambach ashirangsin, Kizpur yasariya. Iyashuch tayaspatampani iwaziri tayaspatakana tárangana; manga.

Yuwash tayaspatataru anush tputsush wanutsshuri yashing' pshturu, an tputs kizpur zunganeerangiya. Isusoo, nuw shiyaa yasatana; mang, tárangu. Násaretshuchish shiya. Apanlltishcha Wipish shiya. ¿Siy tamakatshasha ningeema? ¿Iyaa kachingamaam nda zandkish? mang táyaru,
Isussha: zamangi shiya. Yashingoo, shtungangi; mang, tárangiya.
Tputssha kizpur nungtarangu, kizpur Ay tákchu, yashingsha shitungarangiya.
Tputssha punirustarangusin, waanpatatin tsiyatarangana. ¿Tamashta tputsush yashing taaru anoo tashitungak? tputs tárangana. ¿Kaneeschee k'kuz tayaspataka?
Uw kuk kizpurparee, tárangana manga. Anurisha Isusoo kuk Galileyshuchish pzapaneerangiya.
Isus Utaáshuchee shaniyshini shitungeeranllu, Sandeekpa, Wangpa, ipuneersin, Simosh pang' pshturangana.
Simsha umeena kanumtarangiya. Simsha Isusoo: Kumini kanumtakcha, táyaru,
Isussha Simoo umeenaa uw putayaru, tunuxinarangiya. Ipuritara ashirangiya. Kizsha mang tputseem yásirangiya.
Zar tapitanu, tputssha wamkuree wanguyaa machtarangana. Kas yutamaa, yashing' zutarangu anootstam Isusungaz kusarangana.
Ichinguru tputs yaktash taakana an kusta kusta ashiranganaya. Pshtushinung shaniyarangana.
Isussha kas yutamaa yararangiya. Yashingootstam tashitungata tashitungata ashirangtamta. Yashing' uru Isusoo natstarangu, itaru Isussha: Yashingoo, zamangi; kamanishpa tárangiya.
Putamsha wandari tapiri ndaturi taraseeru, Isus shitungarangiya. Upusupsha naatarangu, Apanllpata tsiyatarangiya.
Simsha wamkurpat ipuneersin, Isusungaz nachungarangana.
Pakeeshtisin, Shiyangaz ichingurusin zandkana; tárangana.
Isussha: Pzaya; nllitaritap tsap naayani; tárangu. Nllitaritap tsap tputsee kamanchima, mang, tárangiya.
Minushsha zari Galileyapsha tsap naatarangu, shaniyshishush zapanish tputs pshtuyaru, tayaspatarangiya. Amb yashingoo tashitungarangitamta. Ashiri yuwaa Isus tayaspatamaam chtarangu anoo kamaneena.
Na minootssha kamanchintspa; yuwaa Isus wanguyaa yararangu anootsi
Anpurtam tputs wanuts itsaptaku an Isusunung tutunlltayaru masharangiya. Shaana zandkush, nuwaa yareerush, tputspa kis ipunpi átana, tárangiya.
Isussha kapung nayanirangu, paxayaru, tputsee patatarangiya. Shiyaa istamaam zandaktana; wanasirirish taangcha, tárangiya.
Natamatamta tputs wanuts yarangiya; tputssha nllitarit ndusha tsachirangana.

Isussha waneerangiya; Na naangcha. Itaru, tputsee kamaniyshpa. Apanllip pang' naakchush, apanllpanee nutseetsish yámandashini. Móysisarinee kamachtamarini tuminungcha. Maachee wanuts Apanlleem mbutamaam wayangcha. Ashkachish anush tputs shiyaa natstachinllinaya; Na yareenlliya táchinllinaya shiyaatsi, tárangiya Isusu.

Isus tárangitaa, naayaranllu, uwsha tputsee kaman kaman kaman ashirangiya. Ashiriya, yusur Isus yaktash kis taamaam pinasarangasha. Itaru, upusap ambirisha taarangiya. Ashiritaa, tputs ichinguru upusap kusataranganaya Isusungazi.

footnotes.text: Nishuri yuwartatam Isáysa 40.3 átu atitamta. Nish píntanaru tsiyatku, “Apanll naanllpa táchiya. Mangeetsis yarangtsa. Ngootseetsinaariya itsinsaru tuwitakpaz shingtsa,” átpaz ashkiya.
